newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks rally at close, banks, finance buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks rally at close, banks, finance buying.

text.p: Thai shares closed 3.50 percent higher on Wednesday as bargain hunters bought heavily into discounted bank and finance counters, brokers said.
The composite SET index finished 21.52 points higher at 635.71 on 6.4 billion baht turnover.
"There was strong buying in bank and finance shares. Investors, especially foreigners, were buying back the shares after selling off over the past two days," said one broker at local major brokerage.
Advancers outnumbered decliners 212 to 101 with 69 counters closed unchanged.
Late bargain hunting in communication shares which were under selling pressure in the morning session also helped boost the overall market, the broker said.
The bank and finance sectors index rose 6.48 and 6.12 percent respectively, while communication issues which were traded lower in the morning were up 3.07 percent.
Bangkok Bank surged eight baht to 171 on the most traded volume of 413 million baht.
Thai Farmers Bank jumped 7.50 to 107 and Siam Commercial Bank was up eight to 118. TelecomAsia gained 3.25 to 37.50.
Thai Airways International closed 5.50 baht higher and limit up at 62.50. Thai Airways shares rose sharply on an expected rise in its profits following the weaker baht, brokers said.
